The command line is not a punishment for avoiding a graphical interface. It is a **composable language for operating a computer**.

::: {.callout-tip}
## Key ideas
`filesystem` `path` `shell` `stdin` `stdout` `stderr`
`pipe` `redirect` `process` `permission` `environment variable`
:::

## The first commands

```bash
pwd
ls -lah
cd project
mkdir results
cp input.csv backup.csv
mv old.txt new.txt
rm temporary.txt
```

Then learn inspection:

```bash
cat file.txt
less file.txt
head file.txt
tail file.txt
grep "ERROR" app.log
```

## The superpower: composition

```bash
grep "ERROR" app.log | sort | uniq -c
```

Read it left to right:

```text
find error lines
      ↓
sort them
      ↓
count unique occurrences
```

## Respect destructive commands
Before running `sudo`, recursive deletion, permission changes, or commands copied blindly from the web, understand what they will modify.
:::
